The '''Crimson Legion'''<ref>[https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=50092 Tabard of the Crimson Legion]</ref> is a contingent of [[Scarlet Crusade]]rs led by [[Saidan Dathrohan|Grand Crusader Saidan Dathrohan]] in the [[Crusaders' Square]] of [[Stratholme]]. Their forces are locked in constant, violent combat with the [[Scourge]],<ref name="Game Guide">[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Game_Guide/World_Dungeons#Stratholme Game Guide/World Dungeons#Stratholme]</ref> but can also be found in strongholds and areas across the [[Eastern Plaguelands|Eastern]] and [[Western Plaguelands]]. They are recognizable by their unique tabards, which differs from the Scarlet Crusade's [[Tabard of the Scarlet Crusade|usual tabard]] by an alternating pattern of white and red, with a white version of their Scarlet flame iconography in the middle.
